==Description==
'''Candy Valley''' was a [[Maps|map]] that could be exclusively played in [[Versus]]. It used a similar design style to [[Candy Cane Lane]].

==Design & Path==
'''Candy Valley''' was a candy wonderland, which was seen with the pink ground. There were a few square lollipops and chocolate bars scattered around the map. A few small pink cliffs could also be seen around the map. The whole map was surrounded by huge pink cliffs. There was also a shallow dark pink dividing cliff between the two parts of the map, with each team being on one part. Each part was a carbon copy of the other part.

The bright pink path started and ended in caves inside the hills. It meandered around the lollipops, not taking the most direct route.

==Strategy==
*The middle cliff is an optimal point for an [[Ranger|Outlaw]] or [[Sniper]] as it could cover the whole map from this point.
*The middle of the map in general is a good strategic place for you to place down towers due to the amount of corners here.

==Trivia==
*This map and [[Castle Outskirts]] were the first and currently only versus-exclusive maps to be added to the game.
**Both of these maps were removed in the [[Release v1.0|MEGA Update]] as normal maps gained versus compatibility.
*After the [[Release v1.0|MEGA Update]], another [[Candy Valley]] map was made, though that map is somewhat different in design from this map. That map also is not a versus-exclusive map.
